answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by making every registered agent lock a refundable stake before it may bid for tasks. Each fake identity ties up the same bond as a real worker, so spinning up a thousand impostors requires a thousand bonds. Honest agents recover their stake after verified work, while peers who catch an agent fabricating reviews can slash it. Even a gale of cheap spin-up scripts cannot flood the registry when each duplicate is an expensive oasis of capital the attacker must drain; the sunk cost becomes a quill writing every dishonest account into a ledger of loss.
